claim_boundary: Retrospective prequential hidden-abstraction benchmark. Protected targets are never rendered into prompts.

evidence: Cold projection work is real, but the mean scan depth is shallow rather than large.
A substantial fraction of one-entry projection requests produce exactly the same projected result already obtainable from the immediately preceding environment state.
Those preceding environment states already carry memoized projection information.
A larger indexed environment representation is therefore not yet forced by the measured scan-cost profile.
Across 369293 cold projection calls, 59.40 percent reached a canonical frame that already existed after projection.
Exact repetition of the raw input identity paired with the mask was only 1.42 percent.
Different operational histories therefore frequently converge only after irrelevant bindings are removed.
Downstream caches already use canonical frame identity once the projected frame has been materialized.
The preregistered bounded family was exhausted without truncation: 16820 instantiations were attempted.
Twenty interfaces matched and 75 unique candidates survived scoring.
None reduced the frozen separation below 8.
The same boundary invariant persisted across 1202 plateau states and 1546 signatures.
Component-level predictors are accurate on cases whose effects stay local to one decomposed part.
The remaining failures concentrate where the result of one part changes the valid interpretation of the next part.
This residual replicates on matched examples even when the local component predictions are correct.
Independent composition of locally correct outputs therefore remains insufficient.
Across 32768 finite worlds, only 6203 residuals have a unique minimum repair.
The remaining 26565 residuals have multiple minimal repairs, with as many as 27 in a single case.
All of these alternatives satisfy the same verifier-level minimality criterion.
Selecting one arbitrary minimum would erase verifier-supported alternatives that may diverge under later evidence.
The implication relation is reflexive and transitive over 4694 equations.
Many syntactically different rows of the implication matrix have exactly identical consequence profiles.
Treating all 22033636 ordered pairs as unrelated labels hides repeated behaviour forced by the implication interface.
Once identical behaviour is grouped, the effective state space becomes much smaller and the remaining dominance structure becomes sparse.
